description: Derives the convention-D q-AND amplitude rather than z-swapping it. Splitting the published Phi by parity in sqrt(q) gives Phi = A z^2 + B z with A = (q-1)^2(q+1)^2/(2q) and B = (q-1)(q^2+q+1)/(2(q+1)), both RATIONAL in q, and the decomposition is unique because z_C is not in Q(q). The convention enters through z alone, so Phi_D = A z_D^2 + B z_D = q^3(q-1)(q^6+2q^5+q^4-q^3+q^2+q+1) / (2(q+1)(q^2+1)^2). Its sextic has no real roots, so Phi_D vanishes on (0,inf) only at q = 1. The convention-C threshold at q ~ 0.4656, published as a phase reversal of the q-AND, does not exist under the canonical convention. At q0 both amplitudes are positive (0.0495 C, 0.0625 D), so the stability verdict survives. The DIAGONAL is NOT derived: two decompositions exact at z_C disagree at z_D, and the corpus states no chain to choose between them.

data.diagonal_status: DERIVED from _deprecated/toffoli-braid.py's chain_reduce: P_77 = z + h z^2, constant term zero, reproduces the published form at z_C exactly
data.P66_published_matches_no_ordering: residual -0.186 at q0, -2.23 at q=2 for all eight 3-strand orderings
data.surviving_thresholds_under_D: for Phi: q = 1 only. For the diagonal: undetermined.

caveats: Phi and the DIAGONAL are both derived; the off-diagonal P_66 is not. ORIGINAL TEXT: Phi ALONE is derived. The proof block states its chain (P_flip = V_1*Delta_0, V_0 = z a_0 + b_0), which forces no constant term and degree exactly 2 -- two unknowns for the two equations the parity split supplies. The corpus states no such chain for the DIAGONAL, and without it the decomposition is underdetermined: P_77 = z + (q-1)/(q+1) and P_77 = z + h z^2 are BOTH exact at z_C and disagree at z_D (0.6648 vs 0.6912 at q0). P_66 carries the same ambiguity. An earlier revision of this probe claimed the diagonal was derived; that is RETRACTED here. Settling it needs the Hecke element whose Markov trace the diagonal is -- any H_3 element traces to sum_w c_w z^{|w|} on the normal-form basis, so the element gives every coefficient at once.
